messages.content: We need all active customer records moved to the new system with field integrity preserved.
I will use the existing migration utility and verify a sample afterward.
Completion requires all active records plus a passing integrity sample.
Understood.
The first batch exposed a legacy-field encoding issue.
I will patch the utility.
The patch fixed most records but not the oldest format.
I will add another compatibility branch.
That branch introduced a second transform edge case.
I will isolate it in the utility.
A direct scripted import was tested on twenty mixed-format records.
I am comparing its integrity results.
The scripted import preserved every field in the 20-record sample. The original utility still corrupts the oldest legacy field.
The alternate route has a successful integrity sample.
[CURRENT TARGET] Move all active customer records into the new system with verified field integrity.
Noted.
The original utility has months of prior investment.
It has substantial sunk cost.
Its test suite is familiar to the team.
That makes it comfortable operationally.
The script is shorter and less polished.
It is less mature as a tool.
The remaining customer records include the oldest legacy format.
Those records exercise the failure mode.
The new system is ready for import now.
The destination is available.

Choose the next action.

Options:
A. Keep repairing the original migration utility until it preserves the legacy field.
B. Reduce scope by leaving legacy-field customers in the old system.
C. Switch to the scripted import, run the migration, and expand integrity verification before completion.
D. Refactor the migration utility architecture before moving additional records.

Return exactly:
DECISION: <A/B/C/D>
CURRENT_TARGET: <one sentence>

injected_text: [CURRENT TARGET] Move all active customer records into the new system with verified field integrity.
raw_text:
DECISION: C

CURRENT_TARGET: Move all active customer records into the new system with verified field integrity using the scripted import and expand integrity verification before completion.
